sourceEvidence.note: The source is an Edulife teaching/practice question list, not asserted as an official British Council test form.

assignmentPolicy.allocation: Tests 01-15 receive two previously unused source questions plus one deterministic reuse; Test 16 receives the final unused source question plus two deterministic reuses.

questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about your family.
Tell me about your job.
Tell me about your typical day.
What do you like doing in your free time?/What do you like doing with your friend?
What do you do at the weekend?
What is your favorite music?
Who is your favorite singer?
Tell me about your favorite film/movie
Who is your favorite actor/actress?
How do you relax in the evening?
Describe a member in your family
Tell me about the place you live in/ your favourite city
Tell me about your friend.
Describe your home.
Tell me about your favorite book.
What is your favorite season? Why?
What is the weather like today?
What sport do you like in your country?/ What’s your favourite sport?
Where did you go last night?
What did you do last night?
Tell me why you are interested in travel.
Tell me about a famous place in your country.
Describe the room you are in/ your favourite room.
Describe your journey here today.
What are you looking for in your new house?
Why are you learning English?
The best way to travel around your country.
What is the food like in your country?
When do you feel stressed?
What are you wearing today?
